bibliographic.title: The Fluid of Life
bibliographic.author: Carl Muckenhoupt
bibliographic.description:
A Speed-IF Jacket game written to fulfil the following book jacket quotes:

A game that manages to be mostly about water, without featuring a single water puzzle. Design error, perhaps? - Sam Kabo Ashwell

Few educational games have the courage to teach _real_ lessons you need in life — this work teaches us all what to _actually_ expect out there in the cold, dark world. - D. Jacob Wildstrom

Achieved a palpable sense of atmosphere with a few well-chosen smells. - J. Robinson Wheeler

The plot twist was so absurd I had to pour myself a stiff drink before continuing. - Jason Dyer
